sam-finance: FYI invoice KYO-2026-007 from Kyoto Consulting shows 10.21% JP withholding. Vendor asks Redwood to gross-up. @mike-tax @rachel-legal can you advise docs needed?

hiro-vendor: Hi Sam — yes, tax withheld at 10.21%. We request gross-up per contract. We can provide Certificate of Tax Residence (CoTR) and bank details. What exact docs do you need?

mike-tax: W-8 not relevant. For JP vendors we need a stamped CoTR (or home country CoTR with Japanese acceptance), vendor Japanese TIN, and a gross-up worksheet (net -> tax -> gross). Also confirm whether fee is service vs royalty.

rachel-legal: Legal will only sign gross-up addendum if: (1) stamped CoTR + English translation, (2) vendor TIN, (3) statement on withholding reason, and (4) signed gross-up addendum. If any missing we deny.

payments-bot: Invoice KYO-2026-007 amount 450,000 JPY. Due 2026-04-30. Status: on hold (awaiting tax docs).

sam-finance: Placing on hold and notifying vendor. Hiro, please upload stamped CoTR scan, translation, TIN, and a line-by-line gross-up calc to https://files.redwood/upload by EOD Wed. Also confirm beneficiary bank SWIFT.

hiro-vendor: Understood — will upload stamped CoTR, English translation, TIN, gross-up calc and MUFG SWIFT by EOD Wed. Thanks for quick turnaround.

mike-tax: Once uploaded I'll review treaty position. If treaty reduces rate to 0% we won't need gross-up.

sam-finance: Thanks everyone. Keeping ticket open until docs received.
